title: Implement content editor drawer
description: Implement the ContentEditorDrawer component. Clicking a section in the section list opens a slide-over drawer with editable fields for all text/image content in that section.
acceptanceCriteria: ContentEditorDrawer is a slide-over drawer (from right) triggered by clicking a section
Shows all editable fields for the selected section
Image fields have an 'Upload' button and show current image preview
Changes update page_data state in real-time (preview updates)
Drawer can be closed without saving (auto-save handled by parent)
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component using shadcn/ui Sheet component. Props: `section: Section | null, onContentChange: (sectionType, field, value) => void, onClose: () => void`. When section is null, drawer is closed.

Based on section type, render the appropriate fields. Use a `SECTION_FIELDS` map: `{ hero: ['headline', 'subheadline', 'ctaText', 'backgroundImage'], services: ['title', 'items[].name', 'items[].description'], ... }`. Render Text, Textarea, or ImageUpload fields per entry.
Image fields: show current image (50x50px thumbnail). 'Change Image' button opens file picker. On file select: POST to /api/batches/[id]/media with the file. Update field value with returned URL.
Take Playwright screenshot with drawer open. Edit a headline field. Verify the preview updates with the new text.
